name: _loader.scss
html:
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
//  space-playground/_loader.scss — the sci-fi system boot loader overlay — spin keyframes, rings, counter, stage readout.
//  Imported by space-playground.scss (manifest) — not compiled standalone.
// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

// ── Sci-Fi System Boot Loader overlay ─────────────────────────────────────────

@keyframes sp-spin-cw {
  to {
    rotate: 360deg;
  }
}

@keyframes sp-spin-ccw {
  to {
    rotate: -360deg;
  }
}

// Boot loader overlay — stays up until the first usable frame renders.
.#{$_B_SP}-loader {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 50;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--color-white-raw);
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  pointer-events: auto;
  overflow: hidden;
  background-color: var(--bg-dark);
  transition:
    opacity 0.8s ease-in-out,
    filter 0.8s ease-in-out;

  &-glow {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background: radial-gradient(
      circle at center,
      rgba($color-blue, 0.4) 0%,
      rgba($color-black, 0.9) 60%,
      rgba($color-black, 1) 100%
    );
  }

  &-grid {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    background-image:
      linear-gradient(to right, rgba($color-white, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px),
      linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba($color-white, 0.03) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: to-rem($space-4xl) to-rem($space-4xl);
    -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(
      ellipse 60% 60% at 50% 50%,
      var(--bg-dark) 70%,
      transparent 100%
    );
    mask-image: radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 60% at 50% 50%, var(--bg-dark) 70%, transparent 100%);
  }

  &-content {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    z-index: 10;
  }

  &-spinner-outer {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 50% auto auto 50%;
    translate: -50% calc(-50% - #{to-rem($space-4xl)});
    width: to-rem($space-8xl);
    height: to-rem($space-8xl);
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    border: 1px solid rgba($color-white, 0.1);
    border-top-color: rgba($color-white, 0.8);
    border-right-color: rgba($color-white, 0.3);
    border-bottom-color: transparent;
    border-left-color: transparent;
    animation: sp-spin-cw 8s linear infinite;
  }

  &-spinner-inner {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 50% auto auto 50%;
    translate: -50% calc(-50% - #{to-rem($space-4xl)});
    width: to-rem($space-9xl);
    height: to-rem($space-9xl);
    border-radius: var(--radius-round);
    border: 1px solid rgba($color-white, 0.05);
    border-bottom-color: rgba($color-white, 0.4);
    animation: sp-spin-ccw 12s linear infinite;
  }

  &-counter {
    width: to-rem($space-4xl);
    height: to-rem($space-4xl);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-3xl);
  }

  &-percent {
    @extend .ttl-md;

    font-weight: 300;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: rgba($color-white, 0.9);
  }

  &-sym {
    @extend .txt-sm;

    color: rgba($color-white, 0.4);
    margin-left: to-rem($space-2xs);
  }

  &-title {
    @extend .ttl-xs;

    letter-spacing: 0.3em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: rgba($color-white, 0.4);
    margin-bottom: to-rem($space-xs);
  }

  &-msg {
    @extend .txt-xs;

    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    color: rgba($color-white, 0.8);
    height: to-rem($space-lg);
    line-height: to-rem($space-lg);
  }

  &-bar {
    width: to-rem($space-9xl);
    height: 1px;
    background-color: rgba($color-white, 0.1);
    margin-top: to-rem($space-md);
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;

    &-fill {
      position: absolute;
      top: 0;
      left: 0;
      bottom: 0;
      width: 0%;
      background-color: rgba($color-white, 0.8);
      transition: width 0.2s ease-out;
    }
  }
}
